## `neuro.array.filter`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Returns the elements of an array that meet the condition specified in a callback function.

## Signatures

```ts
filter(input: { array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: T; index: number; array: T[]) => boolean; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<S[]>
filter(input: { array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: T; index: number; array: T[]) => unknown; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.filter` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
